budget_items.what_was_recorded: Twenty-three FY2022 capital requests were recorded as totaling $2,547,312.
budget_items.quote: there were 23 capital requests totaling $2,547,312 for fy 2022.

budget_items.quote: $688,825 of that amount towards the fy22 capital plan,

budget_items.quote: project title: infra20-01 flat hill culvert reconstruction project cost: $428,500

budget_items.quote: asked about the flat hill drainage project cost of $458,500.00

budget_items.quote: project title: dpw17-07 6 wheel dump truck with plow and sander project cost: $211,000

budget_items.quote: the fire department's operating budget has been historically funded at $10,000/year to replace protective equipment.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two marked police cruiser replacements are each budgeted at $66,950.
budget_items.quote: project title: pd17-02b hybrid replacement marked police cruiser project cost: $66,950

budget_items.quote: our five year average expenditure on capital is $1.06m and the three year average is $1.44m.

budget_items.quote: current balance approx.$1.2m.
